Name: Black Shuck Dog Reskin - Content Patcher update
Author: Kaunisenkeli
Description:
This is a simple mod based on the legend of the Black Shuck, a large, demonic, and ghostly dog with red eyes. Legend has it that this dangerous beast wandered the East Anglia area of England, and now you can have one on your farm in Stardew Valley. Those lovely piercing, red eyes and translucent black fur are two features of this adorable beast of the pit.

Now with a new dog style to choose from and the ability to use this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.


[/url]Installation:
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Unzip mod folder into /Stardew Valley/game/Mods/
4. Start the game, choose between the first two dog styles, and enjoy.

Note: The original XNB replacement file is still available.
